hero.h1: Turn your streams into revenue, on autopilot.
hero.lead: Chalyb runs AI engines that clip your best moments, automate your live production and watch the markets 24/7. One account, one dashboard, live in under a minute.
hero.micro: Free plan · No credit card required

pillars.title: Three engines. One account.
pillars.desc: Every engine runs on the same infrastructure we operate for ourselves. Try any of them in simulation before going live.

items.title: Your best moments, clipped automatically.
items.body: Connect your stream and the AI finds the highlights, renders them vertical and exports them ready to post. No editing, no timeline scrubbing.
bullets: AI detects the moments worth posting
Vertical 9:16 render with your brand kit
One-click export to TikTok, Reels and Shorts

items.title: Run your broadcast from one panel.
items.body: Scenes, overlays and alerts switch themselves based on what's happening on stream. You stay on camera; the engine runs production.
bullets: Stream automation rules you set once
Connects with ChalybClip for live clipping

items.title: Signals that work while you sleep.
items.body: Backtested strategies watch the markets 24/7 and alert you in real time. Run everything in simulation first, then go live when the numbers earn it.
bullets: Simulation mode before a single real trade

steps.title: Sign up & connect
steps.body: Create your free account with Google or email, then link your stream, Drive folder or exchange. Under a minute.

steps.title: Pick an engine & configure
steps.body: Choose ChalybClip, ChalybOBS or ChalybCrypto. Set your brand kit and rules once. Everything runs in simulation until you say go.

steps.title: Publish & earn
steps.body: Clips export themselves, streams run themselves, signals arrive on time. Upgrade when it pays for itself.

pricing.title: Start free. Scale when it pays.
pricing.desc: No contracts, no sales calls. Pick a plan and you're running in under a minute.
pricing.note: Prices in MXN. Cancel anytime from your dashboard.

welcome.title: Welcome to Chalyb
welcome.body: This is your workspace. Here's the essentials in a minute — you can see it later or close it anytime.

nav.title: Your menu
nav.body: Navigate everything from here, grouped into Your account, Platform and Settings. Switch sections in one click.

engines.title: Your engines
engines.body: Under “My engines” you view, open and activate engines (ChalybClip, ChalybCrypto and more). “Live” = running; “Available” = ready to use on your plan.

tokens.title: Your token balance
tokens.body: Under “Usage” you check how many AI tokens you have left this month and your consumption. Out of tokens? Top up or upgrade.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.body: Under “Subscription” you compare Free, Pro and VIP and switch plans. “Billing” has your payments and receipts.

account.title: Your info
account.body: Under “Profile & security” you update your details, change your password and enable two-factor auth.

help.title: Need help?
help.body: “Messages” is a direct line to the Chalyb team, and “Help” has guides and support. We've got you.
